【原视频简介】
The world starts as a 1 by 1, but for every new advancement earned, it expands. Can we complete every Minecraft task in such small world? 

This challenge was completed with the Blaze and Caves Advancement pack: https://modrinth.com/datapack/blazeandcaves-advancements-pack
Blaze and Caves Border Expansion mod by @sloimay
The mod will soon be released on my Discord!

Where I get my music: https://share.epidemicsound.com/30xq36
Discord: https://discord.gg/6pBBqCF3BW

This is another border challenge like Every Unique Item Expands the Border
